attempts.summary: Created a local CA "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (RSA-4096, self-signed, 10-year validity) and installed it as a trusted system CA via /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors and update-ca-trust extract. Verified trust via `trust list`, presence in the system ca-bundle, and openssl verify. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued a non-interactive reboot whose acknowledgement returned before disconnection, polled until exec was available again, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified the CA is still trusted post-reboot.
